g.text: read / write — per-tenant paths + item-level scope
2 /api/* + /ws/* forwarded to the private ALB via VPC origin
4 Coordinator relays the agent turn (HTTPS + bearer JWT); SSE streamed back
5 ECS RunTask launches one Fargate worker per eval job
7 Live updates pushed to the browser over wss
Where agent turns run. In cloud, USER turns run in the AgentCore microVM — the relay replaces the in-process turn, it
does not add to it. Completion and orchestrator turns still run IN-PROCESS in the coordinator, which is why both take the
same per-(user, project) session claim: they write the same session and must never do it concurrently.
Tenant isolation. Per-user EFS paths (access point squashes to UID 1000) + app-layer authorization. All compute runs
